summary: [standards] Resuming an interrupted run after its last brief write can permanently omit the post-migration seal. If interruption happens before the journal is marked complete and before seal runs, all briefs are already new-format. The resumed plan has no non-rebuild effects: resume_backup reuses the original backup and migrate_briefs::apply marks its journal complete, but rebuild_index only calls seal when the current plan has a non-rebuild effect. The backup therefore still lacks tree-after.json; changed_since_migrate treats that as an older backup and skips protection, allowing later edits or deletions of a pre-existing already-0.31 unapproved brief to be overwritten by revert. Fix: seal the reused backup after successfully completing a resumed migration even when no rewriting remained; add an interruption case with all new brief bytes present, journal incomplete and no seal. Blast radius: later-change protection after resumed migrations. Source-path inspection only; current test restores one old brief before resume, which forces a rewrite and masks this route.
